product_overview: Thumbfa.st is an AI YouTube-thumbnail generator SaaS with an admin-facing feature flags page for controlling lightweight product toggles. Platform admins can view declared flags, enable the Thumbnail Agent beta flag, and then access the corresponding organization navigation entry.
core_goals: Sign in with email and password using the test account
View and manage platform feature flags as an admin
Enable the Thumbnail Agent beta flag
Access the Agent beta navigation entry inside an organization workspace once the flag is enabled

features.name: Password sign-in
features.description: Allows a user to sign in with email and password from the sign-in page.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/signin -> Click the "Use password" option to reveal email and password fields -> Enter email credentials -> Enter password credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> Land in the authenticated app

features.name: Admin Feature Flags list
features.description: Shows platform admins a table of declared feature flags with descriptions and toggle switches, and lets them change the enabled state of each flag.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/signin -> Use password sign-in to access the authenticated app -> Navigate to /admin/feature-flags -> View the feature flags table with Flag, Description, and Enabled columns -> Observe the declared flags listed with visible toggle switches -> Toggle the Thumbnail Agent (beta) flag on -> See a success confirmation toast

Navigate to /auth/signin -> Use password sign-in to access the authenticated app -> Navigate to /admin/feature-flags -> View the declared flags listed in the table -> Toggle the Thumbnail Agent (beta) flag off -> See the enabled state update in the list

features.name: Agent nav link unlock
features.description: Shows an Agent beta navigation link in an organization workspace sidebar when the Thumbnail Agent feature flag is enabled for an organization owner or admin.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/signin -> Use password sign-in to access the authenticated app -> Navigate to /admin/feature-flags -> Enable the Thumbnail Agent (beta) flag -> Navigate to an organization workspace at /orgs/$orgSlug -> Observe the left sidebar under the Thumbnails group -> See the Agent link with a Beta badge

Navigate to /auth/signin -> Use password sign-in to access the authenticated app -> Navigate to /admin/feature-flags -> Disable the Thumbnail Agent (beta) flag -> Navigate to an organization workspace at /orgs/$orgSlug -> Observe the left sidebar under the Thumbnails group -> Confirm the Agent link is not shown

routes.description: Sign-in page. Defaults to email OTP; a "Use password" button reveals email + password fields for password sign-in.
Admin dashboard (platform admin only; redirects non-admins to home).
Admin Feature Flags page. Lists declared feature flags and generation routing as a single table with toggle switches.
Organization workspace with a left sidebar. The sidebar shows an "Agent" (Beta) link under the Thumbnails group when the thumbnail-agent flag is enabled and the user is an org admin/owner.
Thumbnail Agent beta page (gated by the thumbnail-agent feature flag + org admin/owner role).

features.name: Password sign-in
features.description: Sign in with email and password via the "Use password" path on the sign-in page.
user_interactions: Click the "Use password" button to reveal email and password fields

features.name: Admin Feature Flags list
features.description: Admin-only page that always lists the declared feature flags (Generation routing APIYI first, Thumbnail Agent beta, Free-plan watermark) and lets the admin toggle each via a switch. Declared flags appear even before a database row exists; descriptions are short and the switch stays visible.
user_interactions: See a table with columns Flag, Description, Enabled

user_interactions.See a \"Generation routing: APIYI first" row with a toggle switch

user_interactions: See a "Thumbnail Agent (beta)" row (key thumbnail-agent) with a short description and a toggle switch
See a "Free-plan watermark" row (key watermark) with a toggle switch
Toggle the Thumbnail Agent switch on

features.name: Agent nav link unlock
features.description: Enabling the thumbnail-agent feature flag makes the "Agent" (Beta) navigation link appear in an organization's sidebar under the Thumbnails group.
user_interactions: With the thumbnail-agent flag enabled, open an organization workspace the user owns
Observe the left sidebar under the Thumbnails group
See an "Agent" link marked with a "Beta" badge

known_limitations.issue: The thumbnail-agent flag may already be enabled in the local database from prior testing, in which case the Agent link is already visible before toggling.
known_limitations.impact: The "off to on" transition may already be "on"; the end state (flag enabled, Agent link visible) is what matters.
